sources.note: Study in Korea (NIIED) GKS scholarship page, degree programmes tab

awarding_body.detail: studyinkorea.go.kr is run by the National Institute for International Education (NIIED) under the Ministry of Education of the Republic of Korea; the page footer names the organisation. Official.
awarding_body.quote: Name of organization : National Institute for International Education(NIIED)

deadline.detail: The selection process on the page states announcement in September, application submission "Embassy Track: September / University Track: September - November", screening October - December, final results December. That matches the record deadline_label exactly, and the month-level precision is honest. The exact opening and closing days differ per embassy and university and are published in the GKS notices, not on this page.
deadline.quote: Application Submission Embassy University — Embassy Track: September / University Track: September - November

eligibility.detail: The page states applicants and both parents must hold non-Korean citizenship; under 25 years of age as of the applicable year; high-school (associate) or high-school/associate (bachelor) graduate or expected; and academic performance of a cumulative score of 80% or higher, top 20% of class, or the CGPA threshold. This matches the record eligibility summary.
eligibility.quote: Nationality: Applicants and both of their parents must hold non-Korean citizenship - Age: Applicants must be under 25 years of age as of the applicable year - Academic Performance: Applicants must meet the academic performance requirements, such as a cumulative score of 80% or higher, ranking within the top 20% of their class

funding.detail: The page lists the scholarship benefits as airfare, Korean language training fees, tuition and monthly allowances, which supports the Fully Funded classification (with the caveat that the monthly allowance is a stipend, not a salary).
funding.quote: Scholarship Benefits: Airfare, Korean language training fees, tuition, and monthly allowances

degree_levels.detail: The undergraduate page covers associate degree (2-3 years) and bachelor's (4-6 years) programmes, matching the record.
degree_levels.quote: Korean language training (1 year) + associate degree programs (2-3 years), bachelor's degree programs (4-6 years)

recommended_field_updates.deadline_text: Embassy Track: September / University Track: September - November
recommended_field_updates.verification_notes: Verified live on studyinkorea.go.kr on 2026-10-12 against NIIED own page. The annual cycle (announcement September, embassy applications September, university track September-November, results December) is stated on the page. The quota page reflects the 2026 intake cycle (about 280 undergraduate students). At the time of checking the "Apply for the GKS" control reported "It is not the application period", so the exact opening/closing days for the current round must come from the GKS notices.

notes_for_reviewer: The month-level window is confirmed verbatim. The exact day-level window lives in the GKS notices rather than on this page, and the apply control said "It is not the application period" at check time - worth re-checking when the September announcement appears.
